notes: T552 (capture the resumable session handle at dispatch) — operator instruction 2026-08-20. THE GAP, CONFIRMED: a finished bake-off lane's directory holds out.md, out.sanitized.md, trailer.log and NO session id (grep of lane artifacts finds none), so every `claude -p` / pi invocation is one-shot and its reasoning is unreachable; asking a lane “why did you decide X” means dispatching a fresh instance to read the artifact as a stranger. We were 90% there: bin/subagent passes `--output-format json` (T521), and that envelope carries a session identifier the parser read past. WHAT WAS BUILT: the session handle is now recorded wherever the token counts are recorded — the run record (untracked/runs/<task>.json: session_id + session_reason stamped ALWAYS, nulls included, self-describing), the lane record (the runner's trailer line: `[runner] session_id=<id>`, or `[runner] session: no handle — <reason>`), and the ledger line (untracked/tokens/tokens.jsonl: session_id + session_reason on every record). SINGLE SOURCE (the T517 lesson): no second parser — tools/token-capture.py parse_claude_envelope() now surfaces session_id / session_id_present in the meta it already returns; tools/runner reads one more field out of it. PER-FAMILY HONESTY (what each actually offers, probed irl): claude — RESUMAUBLE, the envelope carries session_id (top-level, ground-truthed against claude 2.1.237) and `claude -p -r <id>` resumes it; deepseek and ollama via pi — RESUMAUBLE TOO, pi persists every session as ~/.pi/agent/sessions/<cwd-slug>/<uuid>.jsonl and `pi --session <uuid>` resumes it, BUT the id is never emitted in the process output, so the runner records null WITH the honest reason (pi never prints the handle; the id is the session-file uuid, discoverable post-hoc in the pi session dir). No family is blank, nothing is invented — the same rule token capture already follows. PROVE IT RESUMES (requirement 3, both done irl through the REAL runner path, detached context, fresh process each): claude — dispatch via tools/runner captured session_id 4409540d-abc3-4730-88c2-edcb79673acb in the run record; `claude -p -r <id> 'What exact word did you reply in our previous turn?'` resumed the SAME session and answered SEEDED (the word it had replied). pi — dispatch via tools/runner (qwen3.8:27b-mlx, local) created session file .../2026-08-20T18-23-00-364Z_01a02069-810c-7598-8547-73332f07ee96.jsonl; `pi --session 01a02069-...` resumed it and answered PISEED. A captured handle that cannot resume would be worse than none; both are genuine. TEST-FIRST (standing tooling rule): tools/regression-session-capture.sh written and shown RED against current code first — quoted red: arm A `KeyError: 'session_id'` (parser did not surface the handle); arms B/C/D failed every new surface check (“trailer session line missing”, “run record session missing”, “ledger session missing”, and the pi null+reason checks) while the pre-existing token/stdout controls PASSED (baseline intact, only the new field missing). After the fix: ALL PASS. Arms: A envelope parse (seeded id surfaced; envelope without the field = null + present=False; garbage invents nothing), B seeded claude lane e2e (session id on run record + trailer + ledger; stdout unwrap unchanged), C null claude lane (envelope without the field → null + reason, nothing invented), D pi lane (null + family-naming reason; stdout and token-missing behaviour unchanged — a normal dispatch is unaffected beyond the extra field), E resume round trip MANUAL (automation needs real credentials, which the controls never touch — the T521 rule; the irl proof above is recorded here). Wired into `zig build test` (build.zig session_capture_regression step, after the T521 token-capture block). AFFECTED REGRESSIONS GREEN: regression-session-capture (ALL PASS), regression-token-capture (ALL PASS), regression-subagent-prompt (ALL CONTROLS PASSED — note: it appears RED under a dispatched leaf because WEIZIGO_AGENT_DEPTH=3 refuses every subagent call; runs green with depth 1), regression-bakeoff-gates / runner-reporting / runner-taskid / runner-guard / runner-brief-telemetry / runner-worktree (all passed). claimlint unchanged (no docs edits). SCOPE DISCIPLINE HELD: this row RECORDS a handle; it does not build session management, a conversation API, or anything that resumes automatically — bin/subagent's dispatch command shape is byte-identical (only its comment documents the second envelope consumer). DELIBERATE NON-CHANGES (supervisor may override): (1) the heartbeat exit beat still carries tokens_in/tokens_out but NOT the session id — the bundle names three surfaces (run record, lane record, ledger line) and the heartbeat is a liveness stream that strips nulls; the id+reason pair lives on the three durable surfaces. (2) token-capture.py's --json reader mode does not aggregate session ids — handles are per-run facts, not per-model aggregates. SUPERVISOR NOTE (bundle item 4, recorded for later scope): a held-handle supervisor could keep sessions addressable BY CONSTRUCTION — e.g. bin/subagent generating a fresh session id and passing it to pi via `--session-id <uuid>` (pi supports exact project session ids) so the handle is known before the run instead of recorded after; this row deliberately did not build that.
